text: After her husband's death, the young witch Elaine Parks moves to Arcata, California, rents an apartment in a Victorian building and [performs rituals to draw a new lover|trigger|calling on unseen powers]. She cooks for men, [feeds them potions of hallucinogens|rules|how it hunts], and recoils when they turn emotional and clingy, and one after another they die. As police find a witch bottle buried with a professor's body, Elaine falls for the officer on the case, still [longing to be loved|wants|to be loved and belong].
